1445-4871-5231-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5231-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

757-3933-5087-7798.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-3933-5087-7798.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Karn's Bastion to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Natural Emergence, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

275-4908-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

670-1619-4142-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6145.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Passageway Seer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Passageway Seer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Passageway Seer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Passageway Seer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

862-1363-1636.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Crimson Kobolds.
You control at least one additional creature,
862-1363-1636.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying its mana cost.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Crimson Kobolds and one other creature you control, returning Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
862-1363-1636.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

140-5313-7433.description:
Activate Treasonous Ogre by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
140-5313-7433.notes: You can also use the {R} made by Treasonous Ogre to cast Exsanguinate for more mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control without summoning sickness

3259-4478-6096.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a Goblin that doesn't have summoning sickness.
3259-4478-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and a Goblin, if needed, as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4478-6096.notes: General Kreat can be the Goblin, as can the creature that starts with Breath of Fury attached.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a land that does not have summoning sickness

153-515-1636.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
153-515-1636.description:
Animate the land that has Squirrel Nest attached using Jolrael.
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-6289-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6289-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

245-1069-4742-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-4742-5499.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

465-2511-3175.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3941-4331-4993-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3941-4331-4993-7010.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

586-1472-2511-5626.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-2511-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

2510-6867-7042.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-6867-7042.description:
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Loyal Sky Bison.
Cast Appa, Loyal Sky Bison from exile by paying {0}.
Appa, Steadfast Guardian triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa, Loyal Sky Bison enters, it triggers, airbending Appa, Steadfast Guardian.
Cast Appa, Steadfast Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-5285-5499-6968.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-5285-5499-6968.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

465-5256-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-5220-6594.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
2034-5220-6594.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2897-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Gigantoplasm
2897-5299-5466.description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Gigantoplasm into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Gigantoplasm's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Gigantoplasm's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Gigantoplasm's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

5078-5741-6595.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

3057-4836-4989.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3057-4836-4989.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Duke Ulder triggers, giving a Bloodthirster haste and myriad until end of turn.
Declare the Bloodthirster targeted in step 1 as an attacker.
The Bloodthirster's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of it tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Bloodthirster token, triggering the token, untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase. You will not exile the Bloodthirster tokens due to The Master.
Repeat.

2034-6014-6659.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Repeat.

1228-2438-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-2438-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3774-4013-4554-4772.description:
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Teferi.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Teferi, which enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing nine loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4929-5365-5445.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Lonis.
4929-5365-5445.description:
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
Lonis' second ability and Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Resolve the Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Clue ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2178-4481-5367.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4481-5367.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2034-4303-4559-4871.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have a combined mana value of ten or greater.
2034-4303-4559-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, adding {C}{C}.
When Metlwork Colossus dies, Slagstone Refinery and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Slagstone Refinery trigger, creating a tapped Powerstone artifact creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Powerstone token and the Treasure token, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.

4896-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
You control a black and a red permanent.
4896-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.

1589-3000-3182-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three legendary creatures.
1589-3000-3182-4050.description:
Activate Sokenzan's second ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
Turntimber Sower triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Sokenzan ability, creating two 1/1 Spirit and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two creatures, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G} and sacrificing three creatures, returning Sokenzan from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

721-2724-3978.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Species Gorger triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Repeat each turn.

933-1061-1869.notablePrerequisites: You have the city's blessing and/or control ten or more permanents.
933-1061-1869.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Timestream Navigator.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator's Ascend ability gives you the city's blessing.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Inalla, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
